purpose: Isolate source_plan provider rejection without changing the active pipeline runs.
method: Three sequential isolated GeminiModel.call requests with the same source_plan prompt, tiny one-source payload, gemini-3.8-flash model, high authoring reasoning and shared cost ledger. Only the sections maxItems constraint differed.

results.error: 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: Request contains an invalid argument.

conclusion: The outbound sections maxItems=40 constraint triggered provider rejection in this controlled comparison. High reasoning itself worked with both alternative schemas. The provider's generic error does not identify its internal cause or a generally applicable threshold.
implemented_change: Removed this upper-bound keyword from the SourcePlan provider schema while retaining a local Pydantic validator limiting the plan to 40 sections. Other schemas retain their existing bounds. Added a separate authoring output allowance of 65536 tokens and a 420-second authoring request timeout, bounded by the remaining run deadline; reasoning tokens consume the same provider output allowance as visible output.

final_actual_schema_probe.schema: Actual corrected SourcePlan class, no probe schema wrapper

limitations: One request per schema variant; not a general Gemini schema-complexity benchmark.
These were diagnostic provider calls, not successful end-to-end document-generation runs.
